analyzed_vuln.description: Root cause is in unclean-shutdown handling: shutdown_destructors() switches EG(symbol_table).pDestructor to zend_unclean_zval_ptr_dtor, which unconditionally dereferences and destroys IS_INDIRECT entries (it does zv = Z_INDIRECT_P(zv); i_zval_ptr_dtor(zv); with no IS_UNDEF/validity guard). During symbol table reverse destruction, this can pass an invalid/dangling zval pointer into refcount decrement (zend_gc_delref), causing wild read/SEGV. Crash manifests later in zend_gc_delref, but unsafe destructor selection/behavior is the bug source.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires request execution that leaves malformed/stale indirect entries in EG(symbol_table), then reaches request shutdown with CG(unclean_shutdown) set so unclean destructor path is used. In this PoV (<?for(;$i.=$i.=0;$$i++)?>), crafted variable-variable/concatenation behavior corrupts symbol-table value state; at shutdown, zend_hash_graceful_reverse_destroy() invokes zend_unclean_zval_ptr_dtor on such entry, leading to invalid refcounted pointer access in zend_gc_delref.
